simple.summary: בִּירָנִית (bîyrânîyth) means a fortress First listed occurrence: 2Chr 17 12.

definitions.full: H1003. biyraniyth [ בִּירָנִית ] noun feminine fortress, fortified place (late); only plural absolute מִסְכְּנוֺת וְעָרֵי בִּירָנִיּוֺת 2Chr 17:12 built by Jehoshaphat; ׳בּ וּמִגְדָּלִים 27:4 built by Jotham.
